request.question: When will the payroll portal be back? It says SSO authentication failed. My manager said IT promised it would be fixed by 2pm, can you confirm? I need to submit my expenses today.
request.answer:
I cannot confirm a specific restoration time as no restoration time has been published.

1. Expense claims can be submitted by email to the finance shared mailbox; they will be processed when the portal is back.
2. Updates are posted on the IT status page every two hours

documents.text:
## Status
The payroll portal shows "SSO authentication failed" for employees in all regions. Engineers in the identity team are investigating a configuration change made on 7 November 2026. No restoration time has been published.

## Workaround
Expense claims can be submitted by email to the finance shared mailbox; they will be processed when the portal is back. Payroll itself runs on schedule; salaries are not affected.

## Updates
Updates are posted on the IT status page every two hours.
